title: IMAGINA DIY biosignal hardware validation checklist
scope: Future ADS1299-based EEG (8-16 ch), ECG/HRV, EDA, respiration and experimental fNIRS boards. Software adapters exist; no device may be connected to a person until every gating item below is completed and signed off by a qualified, independent reviewer.
prohibited: Electrical stimulation of any kind (tDCS, tACS, TMS, electrical feedback)
Mains-powered equipment in galvanic contact with a person without certified medical-grade isolation
Connecting unvalidated home-built electronics to a person
Presenting the system as an approved medical device

items.check: Battery-only operation during human connection, or certified medical-grade isolation (IEC 60601-1 2xMOPP) for any mains-connected path
Patient leakage current measured under normal and single-fault conditions against IEC 60601-1 limits for type BF applied parts
Data link isolation verified (optical/wireless or certified digital isolator) between participant-side electronics and any PC
Single-fault analysis: shorted electrode, reversed battery, failed isolator, firmware lock-up
Current-limiting on every applied electrode / bias drive (ADS1299 BIAS/RLD) verified
Independent biomedical electrical-safety review and written sign-off
Input-referred noise with shorted inputs (uVrms, 0.5-45 Hz) per channel
Gain and ADC scaling verified with a calibrated signal generator (LSB matches ADS1299Config.lsb_uv)
CMRR and 50/60 Hz rejection measured
Sample-rate accuracy and clock drift (ppm) measured against a reference; compare with SyncEngine estimates
Frame loss / CRC error rate over 1 h continuous streaming on each transport
End-to-end latency measured with a hardware marker (photodiode or TTL) to bound constant transport latency
ECG R-peak timing, EDA, respiration and fNIRS outputs compared with a reference device
fNIRS: emitter wavelengths measured, optode geometry recorded, source safety (optical power/thermal) verified
Provider passes replay/synthetic test suite with recorded bench data
Disconnect, dropout and stale-data handling verified on the physical link
Controller remains in ACTIVE_SHADOW; FeedbackAuthorization fields completed before any FEEDBACK_RESEARCH session
Emergency stop and session time limit tested with the device connected to a phantom
Ethics/IRB approval for the specific protocol
Informed consent covering biosignal storage, retention and sharing
Trained supervisor present for every session
Adverse-event reporting procedure and stopping rules documented
